dissents: Judges disagree on whether the 'clean up old scripts' goal was achieved: evidence shows validation logs, README status changes, and a qc-panel.js fix, but no demonstrated cleanup/removal of old scripts.
extras: Changed scripts/qc-panel.js Codex dispatch behavior so gpt-5.5/Codex paths invoke codex even when QC_AGY_BIN is not codex.

refuted_misses: Clean up old scripts is not demonstrated by the phase-7 artifacts; the diff/logs show validation evidence and a qc-panel.js fix, but no cleanup or removal of legacy scripts.
survived_misses: No evidence that “clean up old scripts” was completed; the phase-7 diff shows validation logs, README status updates, and a `qc-panel.js` fix, but no removal or cleanup of old script artifacts.
